role: CI gate: every NSPrivacyCollectedDataType and purpose value in each PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy is in Apple's published vocabulary list.
toplevel: cd to repo root. find PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy excluding .claude/DerivedData/build/.build; none -> 2. For each manifest, Python plistlib prints types then purposes; each must be in VALID_TYPES / VALID_PURPOSES (else error). bad>0 -> exit 1; zero values checked -> 2; else clean. Wired: ci.yml and Makefile infoplist-guard only; gates.yml runs the other two infoplist-guard scripts and omits this one.

flags.text: Not run by the push workflow gates.yml, which runs check_no_health_data_in_cloudkit.sh and check_infoplist_key_drift.sh directly ('the plutil-free two') although this script uses Python plistlib, not plutil. A Python failure inside the process substitution yields no values for that manifest instead of an error.

Comment says the manifest list uses a here-string 'rather than process substitution' so a sandbox without /dev/fd cannot produce a clean result, yet both value loops read from process substitution; there, a failed substitution yields no values for that manifest.
